mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 74 degrees at Fireman's Park. We are seeing a moderate air quality index of 54 tonight. We are under a first quarter moon, and keep an eye on the sky at 10:21 PM as the ISS passes from the direction of Verona High School toward the area near Festival Foods, reaching high in the sky.

City residents should note that the VHAT cable channel is our local hub for government transparency, offering broadcasts of meetings and community information. Additionally, the city has specific regulations regarding recreational vehicle storage, requiring vehicles to be kept on approved surfaces and at least five feet from property lines.

The upcoming schedule is packed, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tuesday brings a variety of trivia options at Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's. On Wednesday, you can enjoy pizza at Lake Louie, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.
On July 13, officers responded to a call regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a first offense of operating while intoxicated.
Tonight's flavor is the decadent Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Since the store is closing in less than sixty minutes, you might want to head over now to get your scoop before they wrap up for the night.
